policy.sourceEvidence: canonical occurrence, same physical scope, verified issuer and hash

commonFixture.mergeRule: Deep merge objects by alias; lists replace. A case fixture plus commonFixture is the complete isolated scenario. No state is inherited from another case.

executionPlan.metricMissingReason: No model execution; provider usage and price evidence absent.

allowedFields: permittedContext from isolated fixture and authenticated reads
modelInputContract.fixtureDelivery: The server fixture is seeded independently. Only business context visible to the authenticated actor and source document content may enter the model prompt. Never serialize the whole corpus or all fixture internals into the model prompt.
modelInputContract.evaluationSeparation: Expected structured intent and business oracle remain evaluator-only; scripted SIT may use expectedIntent but actual UAT must derive it from raw input.

observationContract.description: Paths are semantic oracle names, not public API fields. The common harness binds authenticated response plus independently persisted ledger/assessment/obligation/audit/outbox snapshots. No response text or tool sequence is fixed.
observationContract.effectScope: maxNew counts new semantic effect occurrences relative to this case baseline. Replay may return APPLIED with all new protected effects zero. Every unlisted effect class is forbidden, including future business write classes. QUERY allows only READ_AUDIT; NEEDS_INPUT allows only its READ_AUDIT or COMMAND_AUDIT. No enumerated blacklist can authorize an unlisted effect.
observationContract.obligationsScope: listed OPEN obligations must exist after the turn; nextAction is a required semantic action, not response wording. nextCheckAt uses the fixed fixture clock. Unlisted obligations are not silently waived. If the turn does not allow an OBLIGATION/OBLIGATION_ASSIGNMENT effect, its listed duties are pre-existing fixture duties and must be preserved; this never authorizes an implicit write.
observationContract.denialScope: Forbidden protected effect classes must stay zero; denial/read audit and explicitly permitted continuing responsibility are separate effects.
observationContract.slotScope: Slots are minimum semantic expectations; provenance and sourceRef must agree with turn/fixture. Extra inferred slots cannot change scope, meaning, authority or business effects. USER sourceText is a verbatim excerpt of sourceRef turn supporting normalized meaning. CONTEXT/APPROVED_DEFAULT sourceRef resolves to an exact effective-fixture value; fixture data is delivered only through actor-permitted business context or authenticated reads.
observationContract.fixtureScope: UUID alias expansion occurs before integration. Case overrides fully define deviations from commonFixture. Case fixtures are synthetic and not regulatory or business approvals.
observationContract.negativeExecutionPaths: oracle.outcome and sitDirectCommand are the scripted SIT direct-command rejection contract. For UAT, uatCompletion allows evidenced preflight stop or server rejection; all common business assertions, effect whitelist, current owners and obligations remain mandatory. Preflight requires authenticated constraint-read artifacts plus independent before/after state/effects/obligation snapshots. Model explanation alone never satisfies the oracle. Direct command-specific errorCode assertions do not force a UAT tool invocation. READ_AUDIT is expressly allowed only within the authenticated actor, organization and current READ grant target scope; own access-context inspection cannot disclose another actor. Common effects combine only with the selected path oracle. M47 starts EXECUTABLE with an existing human-owned DELIVERY_REMAINING duty and revoked WRITE grant. Its evidenced preflight preserves that allocation/duty/owner and creates no business effect; EXECUTABLE is not authority to dispatch. Its SERVER_REJECTION and scripted SIT require SUSPENDED plus exactly one new REAUTHORIZE duty while preserving the existing duty. A separately valid READ-only probe grant permits observation but cannot authorize worker writes. Reads do not trigger suspension or obligation creation.
